Philosophy explores a wide range of fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, values, reason, mind, and language. Different branches of philosophy delve into topics such as ethics, which evaluates moral principles; metaphysics, which probes the nature of reality; and epistemology, which examines the nature and scope of knowledge. Philosophical inquiry often influences other disciplines by framing conceptual foundations and posing critical questions.
